title: HeadsUp — Live Disruption & Safety Alerts
description: Answers whether official weather and safety alerts are active for a place right now: what is happening, how serious it is, where exactly and until when. Live data from the US National Weather Service (US and territories) and Environment and Climate Change Canada; other countries get an honest outside-coverage answer with links to their official warning agency.

supportedIntents.description: Any active official alerts for a city, county, state, province or country.
A yes/no or list answer for one hazard or alert kind, e.g. floods, heat, tornadoes, winter storms.
example: is there a heat advisory in Phoenix

supportedIntents.description: Alerts at the searcher's location (from userLocation, or the device location if they allow it).

hazards.description: Hazard family the query is about, if any.

tiers.description: Kind of alert asked for, if any.

schema.description: An alert lookup request. The place itself comes from the HD_LOCATION entity (or userLocation for near-me queries).

filters.description: Optional narrowing of the alerts shown.

nearMe.description: Use the searcher's location instead of a named place.
